scope: Experimental selection-replacement wrapper, not official modified Manc-COJO
phenotypes: All simulated; no AWI-Gen data or biological discovery claims
lambda_rule: Tune using matched LD only: among lambdas with tuning held-out pooled null rate <=0.10, maximize mean(recall-FDP) across alternatives and tuning strata; ties choose larger lambda. If none qualify choose 2.5 and flag. Freeze before validation calibration.
threshold_rule: Per stratum, LD and method, strict exceedance of rank ceil((C+1)*0.95) of independent calibration maximum scores. Frequency ties conservative; cutoff 1 means no selections, retained as negative finding.
primary: Bootstrap LASSO selection then official Manc --cojo-joint versus official Manc --cojo-slct; both GCTA effect mode and same .ma/.ld/.frq inputs; --extract masks only
secondary: Exact shared inclusion rho0.8 pi0.2 tau0.15
standardization: Manc GCTA Q from effective n and 2f(1-f); H=Q/Vp; t=sqrt(diag(H))*beta; A=diag(H)^(-1/2)*H*diag(H)^(-1/2); z=sqrt(diag(H))*b
objective: Sum_k [0.5 t_k^T A_k t_k - z_k^T t_k + lambda ||t_k||_1]; ordinary elementwise LASSO, no group penalty or forced shared effects
bootstrap: Independent populations; z*_k=z_k+chol(A_k)^T e_k with independent standard normal e; saturated pilot, fixed LD/frequency/variance. Equivalent q*~N(q,Vp Q). Not row bootstrap; does not integrate external-LD uncertainty.
selection: Within each bootstrap a marker selected if either population coefficient nonzero (absolute >1e-8); frequency is fraction selected across B; no PIP, FDR guarantee or confidence-interval interpretation
joint_refit: Official executable --cojo-joint on selected --extract SNPs; retain official collinearity safeguards and record proposed versus retained sets. No inferential validity claimed for post-selection SE or P values.

solver.method: R vectorized coordinate descent on summary Gram matrices
solver.control: glmnet on Cholesky pseudo-data and direct KKT checks

failure_policy: Stop calibration on any error; stop evaluation shard on nonfinite/failed numerical fit, preserve checkpoint and error; do not omit datasets. Finite Bayesian nonconvergence flagged and retained. No ridge repair of non-PD Gram matrices.
stability: First 5 evaluation replicates per scenario and stratum: independent B100 parametric selector repeat and original stepwise on one independent working-likelihood perturbation. Report bootstrap algorithmic Jaccard separately from common summary-perturbation Jaccard for both primary pipelines. Empty-empty Jaccard=1.
row_diagnostic: Numerical-control cases use genuine within-population participant row bootstrap and fixed-design Gaussian residual simulation; assess summary covariance and selection frequencies separately. Never substitute row resampling for primary summary-input method.
metrics: LD-aware one-to-one recall r2>=0.8 per population
uncertainty: Equal weight to 12 fixed strata; paired per-dataset differences then stratified Monte Carlo SE; 95% normal MC intervals, not reference-panel uncertainty. Null Wilson intervals also reported. No nonnull FDR or genome-wide error guarantee.
freeze: Commit design and numerical-tested implementation before tuning; freeze selected lambda then calibration thresholds and hashes before validation evaluation
